description: Test suite for HTTP/2 frame structures in quiche, focusing on Http2FrameHeader and related classes, including various unit tests and macros.

classes.name: Http2FrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of an HTTP/2 frame, including payload length, type, flags, and stream ID.

classes.name: Http2PriorityFields
classes.description: Contains priority information for HTTP/2 streams, including stream dependency, weight, and exclusivity.

classes.name: Http2RstStreamFields
classes.description: Represents the RST_STREAM frame fields, including error code.

classes.name: Http2SettingFields
classes.description: Represents individual HTTP/2 setting parameters and their values.

classes.name: Http2PushPromiseFields
classes.description: Represents the PUSH_PROMISE frame's promised stream ID.

classes.name: Http2PingFields
classes.description: Represents the opaque bytes in a PING frame.

classes.name: Http2GoAwayFields
classes.description: Represents the GOAWAY frame's last stream ID and error code.

classes.name: Http2WindowUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents the WINDOW_UPDATE frame's size increment.

classes.name: Http2AltSvcFields
classes.description: Represents the ALTSVC frame's origin length.

classes.name: Http2PriorityUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents the prioritized stream ID in a PRIORITY_UPDATE frame.

methods.name: IncrementEnum
methods.description: Increments an enum value to the next value.

methods.name: VerifyRandomCalls
methods.description: Verifies that randomization functions produce consistent results.
